producer_report.summary: Rewrote docs/design/study-capability-m1.md as revision 2 and added one CHANGELOG.md entry. §10 is new. §10.2 is a response table with one row for each of the 17 findings in review 1 (M1–M7, m1–m8, n1–n2). The header names the BRIEF.md snapshot, commit c6004fd556094a943f98834c83f282a98390130d, and gives `git show c6004fd:BRIEF.md` so a reader needs no job records. The redaction row of §10.2 cites BRIEF.md:299 directly. §5.4, §8 and §10.3 say the planted-fault test for "Inferred shown as stated" waits for the Pages template design, and the re-review is asked to confirm that order. Design changes: evidence rules are non-waivable, and other waivers must be user-written; runs are pinned, with rules for commit, pull-request and run citations and for `both` claims; the judgment rules were rewritten as structural checks (`quote`, `contradicts`) or named as verifier duties; the §5.1 model gains regions, sub-units, `evaluated-by`, unhandled failures and human timeout; a new §2.1 covers containment, per-run caps, redaction and prompt injection; a replay step and the capture streams were added; alternatives were fixed, including a new A2-D; the §5.3 example was corrected. The review file and BRIEF.md are untouched; `git status --short` shows only CHANGELOG.md and the design doc modified.
